scope: Recorded MAME CPU writes projected onto unchanged actual renderer; no actual native CPU acceptance
clock_projection: Absolute MAME machine.time.as_ticks(48000000) (integer floor) minus recorded frame330 notifier tick; no pixel/frame shifts or fitted phase. Sub-master-clock fractions are not recorded.
elapsed_scope: The same recorded native330 counter phase used by the successful native timed fixture; duration exactly30 fields. MAME notifier and native boundary both start blanking at240,0.
background_scope: Fixed target snapshot background64, not replayed background history
refresh_scope: Same isolated fixture/controller cadence; not restored full native controller state
